newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia's Aluvic aluminium sees profit rise.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia's Aluvic aluminium sees profit rise.

text.p: Aluminium Smelters of Victoria Pty Ltd (Aluvic) said on Thursday it had an unaudited operating profit of A$$23.1 million before tax for the half-year to December 31, down from A$33.6 million a year earlier.
Aluvic said the result was achieved against a background of a stronger Australian dollar and weak commodity prices, which had had a significant impact some of its rivals in 1996.
Aluvic is wholly owned by the state government of Victoria, acting as a holding company for several aluminium businesses.
Aluvic's major investment is in primary smelting.
The company holds a 25 percent interest in the Portland Aluminium Smelter joint venture, which produces about 294,000 tonnes of primary aluminium annually, mostly for sale in Asia.

"We're very pleased with this result because continue to demonstrate the benefits of the effort we've put into our financial risk management strategies to protect Aluvic's earnings against adverse exchange rate and aluminium price movements," managing director Greg Turnidge said in a statement.
